comment: English (United States) for the Faixa de Opções: overlays ribbon/definition.json (pt-BR) and the strings used in code. Office terms, as in Outlook for Microsoft 365.

paste.label: Paste
paste.tip: Add content on the Clipboard to your message.

pasteNoFormatting.label: Paste without Formatting
pasteNoFormatting.tip: Paste only the text, without the source formatting.

pasteQuote.label: Paste as Quotation
pasteQuote.tip: Paste the content as quoted text.

cut.label: Cut
cut.tip: Remove the selection and put it on the Clipboard.

copy.label: Copy
copy.tip: Put a copy of the selection on the Clipboard.

painter.label: Format Painter
painter.tip: Copy the formatting of the selection and apply it somewhere else. Double-click to apply it in several places; Esc stops. From the keyboard: Ctrl+Alt+C copies and Ctrl+Alt+V applies.

fontName.label: Font
fontName.tip: Pick a new font for your text.

fontSize.label: Font Size
fontSize.tip: Change the size of your text, in points.

growFont.label: Increase Font Size
growFont.tip: Make your text a bit bigger: the next size in the list.

shrinkFont.label: Decrease Font Size
shrinkFont.tip: Make your text a bit smaller: the previous size in the list.

changeCase.label: Change Case
changeCase.tip: Change the selected text to uppercase, lowercase or other common capitalizations. With the cursor in a word, it applies to the whole word.

clearFormatting.label: Clear All Formatting
clearFormatting.tip: Remove all formatting from the selection and set the paragraph back to the Normal style.

bold.label: Bold
bold.tip: Make your text bold. With the cursor in a word, it applies to the whole word.

strikethrough.label: Strikethrough
strikethrough.tip: Cross something out by drawing a line through it.

subscript.label: Subscript
subscript.tip: Type very small letters just below the line of text.

superscript.label: Superscript
superscript.tip: Type very small letters just above the line of text.

hilite.label: Text Highlight Color
hilite.tip: Make text stand out by highlighting it in a bright color, like a marker.

foreColor.label: Font Color
foreColor.tip: Change the color of your text.

multilevel.label: Multilevel List
multilevel.tip: Organize items in several levels (1. → a. → i.).

outdent.label: Decrease Indent
outdent.tip: Move the paragraph closer to the margin.

indent.label: Increase Indent
indent.tip: Move the paragraph farther away from the margin.

sort.label: Sort
sort.tip: Put the selected paragraphs or items in alphabetical order.

showMarks.label: Show/Hide ¶
showMarks.tip: Show paragraph marks. The marks are not sent with the message.

alignLeft.label: Align Left
alignLeft.tip: Align your content with the left margin.

alignCenter.label: Center
alignCenter.tip: Center your content on the page.

alignRight.label: Align Right
alignRight.tip: Align your content with the right margin.

alignJustify.label: Justify
alignJustify.tip: Distribute your text evenly between the margins.

lineSpacing.label: Line and Paragraph Spacing
lineSpacing.tip: Choose how much space appears between lines of text and between paragraphs.

shading.label: Shading
shading.tip: Color the background behind the paragraph.

styles.label: Styles
styles.tip: Apply a style to the paragraph.

changeStyles.label: Change Styles
changeStyles.tip: Change the set of styles, colors and fonts of the theme.

replace.label: Replace
replace.tip: Search for text and replace it.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.tip: Zoom in or out of the message. It doesn't change what is sent.

addressBook.label: Address Book
addressBook.tip: Choose recipients for To, Cc and Bcc from your address books. F9 shows the contacts beside the message.

checkNames.label: Check Names
checkNames.tip: Check the names typed in To, Cc and Bcc against your address books. In the To box, the shortcut is Ctrl+K.

attachFile.label: Attach File
attachFile.tip: Attach files from your computer, through Filelink, a web page or your business card.

insertLink.label: Link
insertLink.tip: Create a link in the selected text.

insertImage.label: Picture
insertImage.tip: Insert a picture in the message body.

signature.label: Signature
signature.tip: Insert one of your signatures. In Signatures… you create signatures and choose each account's default for new messages and for replies and forwards.

followUp.label: Follow Up
followUp.tip: Flag the message for follow-up: after it's sent, the copy in Sent gets a star, so you remember to chase the reply. In the menu, also for the recipients.

deliveryReceipt.label: Request a Delivery Receipt
deliveryReceipt.tip: Ask the recipient's mail server to report that the message was delivered (delivery status notification). Not every server sends it.

returnReceipt.label: Request a Read Receipt
returnReceipt.tip: Ask the recipient to confirm when they open the message. They can decline, and some mail programs don't answer.

priorityHigh.label: High Importance
priorityHigh.tip: Mark the message as high importance (X-Priority 1).

priorityLow.label: Low Importance
priorityLow.tip: Mark the message as low importance (X-Priority 5).

formatHTML.label: HTML
formatHTML.tip: Send the message as HTML, with a plain-text version for recipients who can't read HTML.

formatPlain.label: Plain Text
formatPlain.tip: Send only plain text, without formatting, as in Outlook: the formatting is removed from the text (one Ctrl+Z brings it back) and the formatting commands are turned off.

redo.label: Redo
redo.tip: Redo the last action you undid.

openDiagnostics.label: Ribbon Diagnostics
openDiagnostics.tip: Ribbon self-test, shortcuts, fonts and the configuration in use. Use “Copy report” to send it to support.

ribbonOptions.label: Ribbon Options…
ribbonOptions.tip: Language, first tab, default font, Enter as in Outlook and shortcut profile.

attachMessage.label: Attach Message
attachMessage.tip: Attach Thunderbird messages to this one, as .eml files (the Outlook Item).

businessCard.label: Business Card
businessCard.tip: Attach your business card (vCard) or a contact's from your address books.

table.label: Table
table.tip: Insert a table: pick how many columns and rows in the grid. With the cursor in a table, the menu also inserts and deletes rows and columns.

pictures.label: Pictures
pictures.tip: Insert a picture from your computer or the web into the message body.

bookmark.label: Bookmark
bookmark.tip: Mark a place in the message with a name (an anchor), so a link can jump to it.

quickParts.label: Quick Parts
quickParts.tip: Insert ready-made pieces of content, yours and your organization's. Select some text and save it as a Quick Part to use it again.

saveQuickPart.label: Save Selection to Quick Part Gallery…

dateTime.label: Date & Time
dateTime.tip: Insert the current date or time, in the format you choose.

emoji.label: Emoji
emoji.tip: Insert an emoji in the text.

symbol.label: Symbol
symbol.tip: Insert symbols that aren't on your keyboard, like copyright, trademark, currency and Greek letters.

hline.label: Horizontal Line
hline.tip: Insert a horizontal line at the cursor.

help.label: Help
help.tip: Open the Ribbon help: what each tab does, signatures, Quick Parts and the keyboard. Your organization can replace it with its own help.

contactSupport.label: Contact Support
contactSupport.tip: Show how to reach your organization's support: email, phone and portal.

keyboardShortcuts.label: Keyboard Shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.tip: Show what each Office shortcut does here, in the chosen shortcut profile, and test the keys.

about.label: About
about.tip: Version of the Ribbon and of Thunderbird.

fileTab.label: File
fileTab.tip: Save, print, ribbon options and close the message.

strings.help.title: Ribbon Help
strings.help.lead: The ribbon brings the Outlook message window ribbon to Thunderbird. Here is what each tab does and where the options are.
strings.help.tab.msg.text: Paste, font and paragraph, Address Book and Check Names, attachments, link, picture, signature, priority, Follow Up and the delivery and read receipts: what almost every message needs.
strings.help.tab.ins.text: Attach files and messages, business cards, signature, table, pictures, link and bookmark, Quick Parts, date and time, emoji, symbol and horizontal line.
strings.help.tab.fmt.text: HTML or plain text, font, paragraph, styles, find and replace, zoom and the Format Painter.
strings.help.tab.help.text: This help, the keyboard shortcuts, the ribbon options and About.
strings.help.collapse: To save space, collapse the ribbon with Ctrl+F1 or the arrow in the right corner: only the tab names stay, and clicking a tab opens its commands over the message.
strings.help.how.names.text: Type part of a name in To and use Check Names (Ctrl+K): the ribbon completes it from your address books and asks when there is more than one. Address Book opens Select Names.
strings.help.how.sig.text: Create as many as you like and pick each account's default, for new messages and for replies. In a message, the Signature button replaces the one that is there.
strings.help.how.qp.text: Select some text in the message and use Insert → Quick Parts → Save Selection to Quick Part Gallery. Then just pick the part in the same menu. The fields (name, title, phone...) come from the account in From.
strings.help.how.table.text: In Insert → Table, move the mouse over the grid and click the size. With the cursor in the table, the same menu inserts and deletes rows and columns.
strings.help.how.preview.text: Point to a font, size, color or style: the selected text shows how it will look, and goes back when the mouse leaves. Only the click applies it. The preview doesn't go into Undo; turn it on or off in the Ribbon Options (Enable Live Preview).
strings.help.how.painter.text: Select the text with the formatting, click the painter and then the text that should look the same. Double-click the painter to apply it in several places; Esc stops.
strings.help.how.plain.text: In Format Text → Format. The formatting leaves the text right away (Ctrl+Z right after brings it back) and the message goes as text only.
strings.help.how.menubar.text: The menu bar starts hidden: the File, Edit, View… menus are one Alt away. To always see it, check Show the menu bar in the ribbon's ⋯ menu or in Ribbon Options.
strings.help.keys.f6: Moves into the ribbon (and through the other areas of the window). The arrows move through the tabs and commands; Enter runs; Esc goes back.
strings.help.keys.ctrlk: In To, Cc or Bcc: Check Names. In the body: insert link.
strings.help.keys.painter: Copies and applies formatting (the Format Painter from the keyboard).
strings.help.keys.more: The Office shortcuts (bold, alignment, styles...) follow the profile chosen in Ribbon Options. On conflicts, Thunderbird keeps the key.
strings.help.trouble.text: Open Ribbon Diagnostics and click Run self-test: a new message opens, each item is checked and the message closes without saving. Use Copy report to send the result to support.
